comments.leaddev-request:
@leaddev implement the app following the slices in `apps/spaceinvaders/docs/how/slices/`.

Pay special attention to the Home page integration with AppShell:
- The Home page must use the AppShell layout (header, footer, flex-grow content area)
- A single "Start Game" button centered in the content area navigates to `/game`
- The Game page canvas must fill the AppShell content area exactly as Breakout does (`flex-grow flex flex-col overflow-hidden`)
- `GameCanvas` must return `<canvas>` as the root element (no wrapper div) — CSS `style={{ display: 'block', width: '100%', height: '100%', touchAction: 'none' }}`
- Dimensions read from `canvas.parentElement.clientWidth/Height`
- `engine.resize()` called **before** `engine.start()` in a single `useEffect`
- Do not bypass or replace the AppShell layout — the game lives inside it
- Reference: `apps/breakout/app/src/components/GameCanvas.tsx`
